Acme Corp Reports Record Q3 Revenue

By Jane Doe · July 28, 2026 · 6 min read

Acme Corp announced record third-quarter revenue of $4.2 billion, up 23% year over year, driven by growth in its AcmeCloud division.

Segment performance

Cloud infrastructure remained the strongest performer. The company also noted margin improvement across all three reporting segments.

Revenue by segment (USD millions)
SegmentQ3 2026Q3 2025Change
AcmeCloud2,4101,780+35%
Devices1,1201,050+7%
Services670590+14%

Guidance

Management raised full-year guidance, citing a stronger enterprise pipeline. CFO Ravi Patel said the company expects continued double-digit growth.

We are seeing durable demand, not a one-time surge.

— Ravi Patel, CFO

Key figures

  • Revenue: $4.2B (+23% YoY)
  • Operating margin: 31.4%
  • Free cash flow: $980M
  • Headcount: 28,400
